# Cert Phone Optional Validation
苏州市房地产监测V3 personnel certificate management page contact phone is optional with format-only validation.

## Problem
- Business requires contact phone to be optional on the personnel certificate detail page
- Original validation had `required: true` which forced input

## Solution
- In `zhi2-web-admin/src/views/company/personnelCertificate/detail.vue`, remove `required: true` from `phone` validation
- Keep only `patterns.contactPhone` regex, allowing empty value to pass

# IsCache Mixin Data Conflict
苏州市房地产监测V3 component `data` defining `isCache` conflicts with `detailMixins` computed of the same name, causing Vue warnings.

## Problem
- `detailMixins` defines `isCache` in `computed`
- Components `AgencyBranchDetail.vue` and `AgencyPersonnelDetail.vue` define `isCache` in `data`, causing conflict and Vue warnings

## Solution
- Remove `isCache` from component `data`
- Override in `computed` returning `false` to disable form sessionStorage cache logic
- Apply same fix to both `AgencyBranchDetail.vue` and `AgencyPersonnelDetail.vue`

## Files and Attribution

# Unit List Dict Misuse
苏州市房地产监测V3 unit list "有无电梯" column wrongly used `sys_include` dictionary, showing raw value 0.

## Problem
- Original "有无电梯" (elevator or not) column used `sys_include` dictionary with no matching value, showing raw value 0
- Affected three views: projectManagement/unitinfo/index.vue, building/unit/index.vue, building/unitChange/index.vue

## Solution
- Switch all three views to use `have_or_not` dictionary from `permitConstants.js` `PLAN_DICT_TYPES.HAVE_OR_NOT`
- If numbers still show, confirm `have_or_not` dictValue in dict management matches interface return value

- Involved files: projectManagement/unitinfo/index.vue, building/unit/index.vue, building/unitChange/index.vue, projectManagement/unitinfo/detail.vue, presale/permit/permitConstants.js
- Project: 苏州市房地产监测V3; source session: 4676abc6-8d97-4393-94eb-00860b189dc6; code baseline: none

# HandleDelete No-Arg Call
苏州市房地产监测V3 toolbar delete button `@click="handleDelete()"` with no row data caused error when accessing undefined row primaryKey.

## Problem
- Toolbar delete button called `handleDelete()` without passing row data
- `table.js` `let ids = row[this.primaryKey]` threw error when `row` was `undefined`

## Solution
- Change `table.js` to `(row && row[this.primaryKey]) || this.ids` to support no-arg batch delete
- Change `brand/index.vue` to `@click="handleDelete"` without parentheses

## Files and Attribution
- Verification: src=苏州市房地产监测V3-leftover/124.md
- Involved files: company/brand/index.vue, mixins/listMixins.js, mixins/table.js

# 详情页data缺字段致按钮组未定义警告
苏州市房地产监测V3 中 `bond/detail.vue` 的 `data()` 未声明关键字段，致 operation-btn-group 绑定属性无响应式定义并报 Vue 警告。

## 问题根因
- `bond/detail.vue` 的 `data()` 未声明 `primaryKey`、`moduleName`、`businessName`
- 致 `operation-btn-group` 绑定属性无响应式定义并报 Vue 警告

## 解决方案
- 于 `data()` 补充 `primaryKey: 'bondId'`、`moduleName: 'prefund'`、`businessName: 'paymentBond'`
- 以对接 `/prefund/paymentBond/*` 接口

## 验证与归属
- 验证证据：src=苏州市房地产监测V3-leftover/019.md
